title: Mad Max: Fury Road
tagline: War rig road trip. Pass the water.
about: Max and Furiosa flee across the desert with a tyrant's escaped wives in a war rig.
cue: Serve the drinks when Immortan Joe opens the water for the crowd below.

Break into shards.Wasteland lizard skewersChicken thigh strips with smoked paprika and cumin, grilled until blackenedHow to make it600g chicken thighs2 tsp smoked paprika1 tsp ground cumin1 tsp chilli flakes200g Greek yoghurt1 garlic clove, crushedsalt, to tasteCut the chicken into strips and rub with the paprika, cumin and chilli. Thread onto skewers.Grill hot until blackened at the edges.Mix the yoghurt with the garlic and salt for a dip.War Boy chrome butter popcornThe War Boys spray chrome before they rideHow to make itAs written, serves 4Popcorn tossed in brown butter, smoked salt and a little chilli, dusted with edible silver lustre so it shines like a War Boy's grin.Pop 150g popping corn in 2 tbsp oil in a covered pot.Melt 60g butter and cook until nut brown.Toss the popcorn with the brown butter, 1 tsp smoked salt and a pinch of chilli flakes.Spread on a tray, cool for 5 minutes and dust lightly with 1 tsp edible silver lustre, tossing to coat.MainsHarissa lamb shoulder with hummusSlow roast harissa lamb shoulder pulled apart, hummus, charred peppers, flatbreadHow to make it1.8kg lamb shoulder3 tbsp harissa3 garlic cloves1 tbsp ground cumin1 tin chickpeas, drained2 tbsp tahini2 red capsicums6 flatbreadssalt, to tasteRub the lamb with the harissa, garlic and cumin.Roast covered at 150°C for 5 hours until it pulls apart.Blitz the chickpeas with the tahini, a splash of water and salt into hummus.Char the capsicums over a flame, peel and slice.Blister the flatbreads in a hot pan and serve tomatoes and 500ml beef stock.Return the beef, cover and braise at 160°C for 2.5 hours, then add 2 drained tins black beans and cook 30 minutes more.Mix 400g self-raising flour with 250ml milk and
